description:
Performance-focused titanium gravel. Exceptional value.

The Enigma Edge MK.II is a versatile titanium gravel frame designed for responsive handling, all-day comfort and confident performance across mixed terrain.

Constructed from 3Al/2.5V titanium, it features a T47 threaded bottom bracket, 44mm head tube, semi-internal cable routing, clearance for 700 × 50mm tyres and a Universal Derailleur Hanger (UDH) dropout. The brushed titanium finish is complemented by contrasting satin bead logos.

SAVE 25% – WAS £2,299, NOW £1,725

Now succeeded by the Enigma Eremos, these remaining Edge MK.II frames are brand new and unused, with a full Enigma warranty.

Please note: The price is for the frame only, including the seat clamp, derailleur hanger and frame fittings. The fork and headset shown in the studio photographs are not included but are available separately. Complete custom builds can also be arranged.
